summary: Iteration 4 — REAL-ONLY mode verification. Director login works and lands on /mission with auto-cycle-toggle and run-cycle-btn present.

issues: A few 3rd-party asset requests fail with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin (non-blocking; likely favicon/analytics).

critical_code_review_comments: routers/withdrawals.py: /treasury/sync correctly guarded by get_current_director; consider adding a rate limit since it triggers RPC calls.
routers/clients.py: PATCH /clients/{id} returns 400 when the payload has only unknown fields (filtered to empty patch). Consider returning 422 and enumerating allowed fields for clarity.
Session-based cookie auth means requests.Session() carries auth cookies across tests after /auth/login; document this to avoid confused negative-auth tests.
